name: 3D Haar Wavelet Compression with Hierarchical Subblocks
aliases: Haar Wavelet Transform, Local Wavelet Compression
definition: A compression scheme using Haar Wavelet Transform applied hierarchically to 16x16x16 unit blocks, dividing data into low frequencies and high frequencies (error matrices) across four levels.
summary: 3D Haar Wavelet Compression with Hierarchical Subblocks compresses volumetric data by applying four levels of Haar transforms to 16x16x16 blocks, prioritizing fast reconstruction over smoothing quality.
